Internal Shapley computation

Source: R/shapley.R
dot-autoiml_shapley_iml.Rd

  • mode = "marginal" matches iml's interventional design.

  • mode = "conditional" uses a lightweight kNN conditional sampler on the provided background data.

Usage

.autoiml_shapley_iml(
  task,
  model,
  x_interest,
  background,
  sample_size = 100L,
  seed = NULL,
  class_labels = NULL,
  mode = c("marginal", "conditional"),
  conditional_k = 5L,
  conditional_weighted = TRUE
)

Arguments

task

mlr3 task

model

trained mlr3 learner

x_interest

1-row data.table/data.frame with task$feature_names

background

data.table/data.frame with task$feature_names

sample_size

integer Monte Carlo sample size

seed

optional integer seed

class_labels

optional character vector; subset classes for multiclass

mode

"marginal" or "conditional"

conditional_k

integer; k for kNN conditional sampling (only for mode="conditional")

conditional_weighted

logical; if TRUE, sample among kNN with weights 1/(dist+eps)

Value

data.table with columns: class_label, feature, phi, phi_var, feature_value, sample_size

Details

This follows a Monte Carlo Shapley scheme:

  • sample random permutations of features

  • for each feature position, estimate the marginal contribution via paired predictions
